_note: ⛔ CCODE-288 — EDITOR TYPE-CHECKING, ZERO DEPENDENCIES. VS Code ships TypeScript and honours this file with nothing installed, so the game stays a no-build-step, zero-dependency ES-module project and we still get contract errors as red squiggles while editing. ⚠️ `checkJs` is FALSE on purpose: checking is OPT-IN per file via a `// @ts-check` comment at the top. Turning it on globally across 98 modules and a 14,257-line app.js would produce a wall of noise nobody reads, which is how a check gets switched off permanently. Opt a module in when you touch it.
_whyThisEarnsItsKeep: ⚠️ Five of eight false findings on 2026-08-28 were contract mistakes a checker catches at EDIT TIME: deathDepth called with an options object when it is positional; chooseTarget's return read as if it were the ally; TARGET_POLICIES treated as an array; an import of `mechanicsOf`, which does not exist; and craft_mechanics passed where the energy block was wanted — that last one nearly became a false headline about a working system Erik had personally ruled on.
